source: House Lords in All Houses (Astro Vaibhav Gupta) - standard Parashari cross-reference

1.1: Good health, strong, famous, long-lived. May have two wives (one may be illicit). Strong-willed and independent.
1.2: Learned, happy, good son, religious, honors, gainful. May have two wives. Good speaker.
1.3: Brave, wealthy, respected, two wives. A famous person, self-made, gains from siblings.
1.4: Happy from mother and father, blessed with comforts, vehicles, and property. Popular, may have many wives.
1.5: Honorable, famous, 'difficult to get son' (or first child lost). Good, but not very rich. Respected by kings.
1.6: Brave, but loses money to enemies. Devoid of maternal happiness. Health issues. Gains from maternal uncle.
1.7: If strong, becomes a king. If weak or afflicted, becomes a wanderer, ascetic, or spouse may not live long. Gains from in-laws.
1.8: Learned in occult, famous, but may be a thief, adulterous, and a gambler. Health issues. Slow progress.
1.9: Fortunate, dear to people, devoted to Vishnu, eloquent speaker, happy, blessed with spouse and son.
1.10: Kingly, famous, respected, self-made wealth, happy parents. Workaholic. Receives honor from government.
1.11: Wealthy, virtuous, famous, gains from father, kingly. Eldest child may suffer. Success in all undertakings.
1.12: Devoid of bodily pleasures, may be a thief, angry, ill-tempered. Loses money. Good for Moksha and foreign settlement.

2.1: Wealthy, gainful, good speaker. May have 2-3 wives. Earns by self-effort. Good family.
2.2: Rich, proud, good family. Devoid of brothers. May have two wives. Excellent for accumulated wealth.
2.3: Brave, wise, good qualities, but suffers from 'lack of fate.' Self-made wealth. Gains through siblings or media.
2.4: Blessed with all kinds of wealth, property, and comforts. Gains from mother. Hard-working.
2.5: Wealthy. Gains from children and speculation. Devoted to wife. May have few sons. Good investor.
2.6: Wealth from enemies, or wealth is lost to enemies. Eye troubles. Gains in foreign lands. Money from service/loans.
2.7: Wealth from spouse or business. Spouse may be from a rich family. Gain after marriage. May have illicit relations.
2.8: Wealth from inheritance or 'dead man's money.' Little happiness from wife. May face losses. Hard work for wealth.
2.9: Fortunate, wealthy, skilled. Gains from father. Good for higher education and religious deeds.
2.10: Reputed, wealthy, respected. Gains from profession. Many comforts. Good speaker. Status in government.
2.11: Excellent for wealth. Gains from all sources. Successful in all ventures. Respected, famous. Good for business.
2.12: Loss of wealth. Spends on good deeds if benefic, on bad deeds if malefic. Gains in foreign land. Eye troubles.

3.1: Self-made wealth. Brave, intelligent, but may have two wives. Good for physical strength and enterprise.
3.2: Devoid of valor, materialistic, unhappy. Earns through skills or siblings. Tries to create wealth.
3.3: Very brave, happy, wealthy. Blessed with friends and siblings. Good for all enterprises. Strong-willed.
3.4: Happy, wealthy, blessed with comforts. Gains from mother. May have issues with father. Skill in architecture.
3.5: Virtuous, wealthy. Happiness from children. Skills in finance, writing, or teaching. Good for speculation.
3.6: Enmity with siblings. Loses money to enemies. Brave. Gains from maternal uncle. Good for service.
3.7: Good spouse, but may have issues with them. Gains from business. Good for travel. Spouse is courageous.
3.8: Troubles with siblings. May be a thief. Loss of courage. Problems in undertakings. Interest in occult.
3.9: Fortunate, makes fortune through self-effort. Good for publishing, writing. Good relations with father.
3.10: Brave, successful, kingly. Happiness from parents. Self-made. Gains status through skills and hard work.
3.11: Very wealthy, gains from siblings. Successful in all ventures. Good for business and networking.
3.12: Loss of siblings. Spends on wrong deeds. May have enmity with father. Gains in foreign land.

4.1: Learned, happy, blessed with comforts. Attached to mother. Good in public life. Gains property.
4.2: Wealthy, good family, gainful. Gains from property, mother, and vehicles. Good speaker.
4.3: Brave, charitable, wealthy. Makes fortune with self-effort. Good for writing about property/vehicles.
4.4: Respected, kingly, virtuous, wealthy. Blessed with all comforts. Powerful in government. Strong connection to mother.
4.5: Devoted to Vishnu. Happy, wealthy, famous. Gains from children, speculation, and property. Raja Yoga.
4.6: Devoid of maternal happiness. Troubles from enemies. Angry, ill-tempered. Loses property due to disputes.
4.7: Learned, respected. Gains property after marriage. Spouse may be educated. Good for public life.
4.8: Devoid of domestic happiness. Loss of property. Ill health. Issues with mother. Gains from inheritance.
4.9: Fortunate, respected, devoted. Gains from father. Blessed with property, vehicles. May build temples.
4.10: Kingly, respected, famous. Gains from profession. Works from home or in real estate. Raja Yoga.
4.11: Very wealthy, charitable, virtuous. Gains from property, mother, and elder siblings. Fulfills desires.
4.12: Devoid of comforts. Loss of property. May live in a foreign land. Spends on property. Issues with mother.

5.1: Learned, famous, kind-hearted. Good for intelligence and children. Respected. Raja Yoga.
5.2: Wealthy, good family, gainful. Gains from children and speculation. Good speaker. Good for investments.
5.3: Wealthy, gains from siblings. Skilled in arts, writing, or finance. Children may be courageous.
5.4: Happy, wealthy, blessed with comforts. Gains from mother. Devoted. Raja Yoga. Good for education.
5.5: Blessed with children. Famous, intelligent, virtuous. Good for mantras, speculation, and teaching.
5.6: Troubles from children. Enmity with son. Health issues for children. May gain from speculation in disputes.
5.7: Virtuous, respected, religious. Spouse is noble and intelligent. Good for business. Love marriage possible.
5.8: Devoid of happiness from children. Breathing troubles. Unsuccessful. Interest in occult and research.
5.9: Fortunate, 'son is the source of fortune.' Famous, author, kingly. Excellent Raja Yoga. Devoted to father/guru.
5.10: Kingly, famous, 'like a king or minister.' Great success in career. Gains from speculation. Raja Yoga.
5.11: Very wealthy, learned, helpful. Gains from children. Success in all undertakings. Good for speculation.
5.12: Devoid of happiness from children. May live in a foreign land. Good for spiritual pursuits (Moksha). Loss in speculation.

6.1: Famous, virtuous, brave. But also sickly, troubled by enemies. Spends on good deeds. Good for service.
6.2: Famous, wealthy, adventurous. Gains from enemies or in foreign lands. Loss of wealth due to disease or disputes.
6.3: Angry, ill-tempered, enmity with brothers. Brave, but suffers from 'lack of fate.' Good for competitive jobs.
6.4: Devoid of maternal happiness. Disputes over property. Wise, but may be deceitful. Loss of vehicles.
6.5: Enmity with son. Selfish, rich, but unhappy. Good for financial speculation (earning from debt).
6.6: Enmity with own people, but friendship with others. Good health, brave. Destroys enemies. Vipareeta Raja Yoga.
6.7: Spouse is sickly or an enemy. Loss of wealth through spouse. Devoid of marital happiness. May have two wives.
6.8: Sickly, troubled by enemies, adulterous. Gains from inheritance. Vipareeta Raja Yoga. Prone to accidents.
6.9: Enmity with father. Loss of fortune. Gains from professions like law. 'Fortune through misfortune.'
6.10: Famous, respected, good in profession. Success in service. Good speaker. But may have troubles with father.
6.11: Wealthy, brave, virtuous. Gains from enemies or service. But may have troubles from elder siblings.
6.12: Spends on bad deeds. Troubled by enemies. Ill health. Loses money in litigation. Vipareeta Raja Yoga.

7.1: Skilled, brave, but afflicted by spouse. Spouse may be dominant. Good for public image. Attracts partners easily.
7.2: Wealth through spouse. Good family. Spouse is a good earner. Multiple relationships possible.
7.3: Happiness from siblings. Spouse is courageous or skillful. Gains from writing or business. Luck rises after marriage.
7.4: Spouse is virtuous and loyal. Gains property after marriage. Attached to mother. Good education.
7.5: Happy, wealthy, virtuous. Spouse is intelligent and noble. Possible love marriage. Good for business.
7.6: Spouse is sickly or an enemy. Devoid of marital happiness. Spouse may be in service (doctor, lawyer).
7.7: Blessed with good spouse. Famous, respected. Good for business and partnerships. Strong, attractive spouse.
7.8: Spouse is sickly or short-lived. Devoid of marital happiness. Gains from in-laws' inheritance. Spouse is secretive.
7.9: Fortunate, blessed with good spouse. Spouse is religious and virtuous. Gains after marriage. Foreign travel.
7.10: Spouse is virtuous and supports career. Gains from profession. Famous. Spouse may be a colleague or in high post.
7.11: Wealth through spouse. Spouse is gainful. Multiple relationships. Good for business partnerships.
7.12: Spouse from a poor family or foreign land. Loss of wealth through spouse. Devoid of marital happiness. Separation.

8.1: Devoid of bodily pleasures. Sickly. Bad reputation (thief, gambler). Learned in occult. Sudden transformations.
8.2: Loss of wealth. Poor. Gains from inheritance. Ill health. Family is separated. Eye troubles.
8.3: Devoid of siblings' happiness. Loss of courage. Ear troubles. Skilled in research. Sudden events.
8.4: Devoid of maternal and domestic happiness. Loss of property. Gains from inheritance. Secretive mind.
8.5: Troubles with children. Few sons. Unstable mind. Gains from speculation. Deep intelligence in occult.
8.6: Troubled by enemies, but also destroys them. Sickly in childhood. Vipareeta Raja Yoga. Gains from disputes.
8.7: Spouse is sickly. Two wives. Devoid of marital happiness. Business may fail. Partner is secretive.
8.8: Long-lived. Good health. But may have bad reputation. Good for occult. Vipareeta Raja Yoga.
8.9: Enmity with father. Loss of fortune. Adulterous. Betrays religion. 'Father of a dead child.'
8.10: Obstacles in career. Breaks in career. Bad reputation. Father may be sickly. Success in research/occult.
8.11: Devoid of gains. Miserable, but wealthy in early life. Gains from inheritance. Elder sibling may suffer.
8.12: Spends on bad deeds. Short-lived. Loses money. Vipareeta Raja Yoga. Good for Moksha and foreign settlement.

9.1: Fortunate, respected, virtuous. Eloquent speaker. Blessed with spouse and son. Raja Yoga.
9.2: Wealthy, learned, good family. Gains from father. Good speaker. Fortunate in all ventures.
9.3: Fortunate through siblings. Brave, wealthy. Good for writing, publishing. Father is self-made.
9.4: Blessed with all comforts. Devoted to mother. Gains property from father. Raja Yoga.
9.5: Fortunate, wealthy. 'Fortune rises with son.' Devoted. Excellent Raja Yoga. Good for teaching/consulting.
9.6: Devoid of fortune. Enmity with maternal uncle. Troubles from enemies. Gains through service or law.
9.7: Fortune rises after marriage. Spouse is virtuous and fortunate. Good for business and foreign travel.
9.8: Devoid of fortune. Troubles with father. Loses inheritance. 'Miserable.' Good for occult/spiritual life.
9.9: Extremely fortunate. Blessed with all comforts. Respected, kingly. Father is long-lived and famous.
9.10: Raja Yoga. 'King of Kings.' Famous, respected. Excellent career. Dharmakarmadhipati Yoga.
9.11: Very wealthy, virtuous, gainful. Gains from father and elder siblings. Fulfills all desires.
9.12: Loss of fortune. Spends on religious deeds. Gains in foreign land. Good for Moksha, but not materialism.

10.1: Learned, famous, kingly. Self-made. Workaholic. Respected. Success in own enterprise.
10.2: Wealthy, good family. Gains from profession. Good speaker. Career in finance, food, or teaching.
10.3: Brave, wealthy. Career in media, writing, or transport. Self-made success. Good for arms/defense.
10.4: Happy, wealthy, blessed with comforts. Career in real estate, vehicles, or working from home. Raja Yoga.
10.5: Kingly, famous, 'minister or king.' Success in speculation, teaching, or government. Raja Yoga.
10.6: Career in service (doctor, lawyer). Troubled by enemies. Obstacles in career. Success in service.
10.7: Success in business. Spouse is virtuous and helps in career. Good for trade and foreign dealings.
10.8: Obstacles in profession. Breaks in career. Bad reputation. Success in occult, research, or insurance.
10.9: Fortunate, kingly, respected. 'Dharmakarmadhipati Yoga.' Success in teaching, law, or religious work.
10.10: Extremely powerful, famous, kingly. Success in profession. Respected by government. Self-made.
10.11: Very wealthy, virtuous, gainful. Success in all undertakings. Gains from career. Powerful Dhana Yoga.
10.12: Loss of profession. Spends on government. Career in foreign land, hospitals, or prisons. Obstacles.

11.1: Wealthy, famous, virtuous. Gainful. Attached to self. Good health. May be greedy.
11.2: Excellent Dhana Yoga. Very wealthy, good family. Gains from all sources. Good speaker.
11.3: Wealthy, skilled. Gains from siblings, writing, or business. Brave. Good for enterprise.
11.4: Gains from mother, property, and vehicles. Happy, wealthy. Good education. Raja Yoga.
11.5: Gains from children, speculation. Happy, wealthy, learned. Good for investments. Raja Yoga.
11.6: Gains from enemies, service. Sickly. May be cruel. Gains in foreign lands. Elder sibling may be in service.
11.7: Gains from spouse or business. Spouse is from a wealthy family. Success in partnerships.
11.8: Loss of gains. Long-lived. Gains from inheritance or occult. Elder sibling may face troubles.
11.9: Fortunate, wealthy, respected. Gains from father and guru. Excellent Dhana Yoga. Religious.
11.10: Gains from profession. Famous, respected, kingly. Success in all ventures. Father is wealthy.
11.11: Extremely wealthy. Gains from all sources. Elder siblings are successful. Fulfills all desires.
11.12: Loss of gains. Spends on good deeds. Gains in foreign lands. Elder sibling may live abroad.

12.1: Spends on self. Weak health. May live in foreign land. Good for Moksha. Devoid of bodily pleasures.
12.2: Loss of wealth. Spends on family. Gains in foreign lands. Eye troubles. Good speaker, but spends on good deeds.
12.3: Loss of siblings. Devoid of valor. Spends on siblings. Good for spiritual writing. Ear troubles.
12.4: Loss of mother, property. Devoid of domestic happiness. May live in foreign land. Spends on vehicles.
12.5: Loss of children. May adopt a son. Spends on religious deeds. Good for spiritual practices and mantras.
12.6: Spends on enemies. Gains from service. Vipareeta Raja Yoga. Devoid of maternal happiness. Sickly.
12.7: Spouse is from a poor family or foreign land. Loss of wealth through spouse. Devoid of marital happiness.
12.8: Gains from inheritance. Virtuous, good speaker. Happy, long-lived. Vipareeta Raja Yoga. Good for occult.
12.9: Loss of fortune. Enmity with father. Spends on religious deeds. May betray religion or gurus.
12.10: Loss of profession. Spends on government. Obstacles in career. May work in foreign land, hospitals, or prisons.
12.11: Loss of gains. Spends on elder siblings. Gains from foreign sources, but wealth is not stable.
12.12: Spends heavily. Good for Moksha. Foreign settlement. Devoid of wealth. Vipareeta Raja Yoga. Good for meditation.
